scripts.dev:prepare: bun run dev:config && bun run db:migrate && bun run db:seed
scripts.dev: sh scripts/tablecast-env.sh 'portless "web.$TABLECAST_HOST" bunx --no-install turbo run dev --filter=@tablecast/web'
scripts.dev:parity: sh scripts/tablecast-env.sh 'portless "web.$TABLECAST_HOST" bunx --no-install turbo run preview --filter=@tablecast/web'
scripts.demo:reset: sh scripts/tablecast-env.sh 'NODE_ENV=development bun scripts/tablecast-runtime.ts --reset && bun --env-file=.local/.env scripts/tablecast-seed.ts --reset'
scripts.test: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts && turbo run test
scripts.check: bun run codegen && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run fallow && bun run test
scripts.db:migrate: CI=1 bun --env-file=.local/.env run cf:local d1 migrations apply 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000 --dir apps/api/migrations --local --persist-to .local/state
scripts.services:up: docker compose --env-file .local/.env up --detach --wait && bun run services:aliases
scripts.services:aliases: bun --env-file=.local/.env exec 'portless alias "grafana.$TABLECAST_HOST" "$(docker compose port tablecast-lgtm 3000 | cut -d: -f2)" && portless alias "mailpit.$TABLECAST_HOST" "$(docker compose port tablecast-mailpit 8025 | cut -d: -f2)" && portless alias "tempo.$TABLECAST_HOST" "$(docker compose port tablecast-lgtm 3200 | cut -d: -f2)" && portless alias "otlp.$TABLECAST_HOST" "$(docker compose port tablecast-lgtm 4318 | cut -d: -f2)"'
scripts.services:down: bun --env-file=.local/.env exec 'docker compose down --timeout 5 && portless alias --remove "grafana.$TABLECAST_HOST" && portless alias --remove "mailpit.$TABLECAST_HOST" && portless alias --remove "tempo.$TABLECAST_HOST" && portless alias --remove "otlp.$TABLECAST_HOST"'
